title: Reuse a field selection
summary: GraphQL: Reuse a field selection. Remove pages from the fragment.
introduction: A fragment gives a group of fields a name. The query spreads that group onto a Book.
learningObjectives: Reuse a field selection with GraphQL

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install graphql@16. Save one example as lesson.mjs and run node lesson.mjs. These examples execute queries locally and do not need an HTTP server.

blocks.title: Reuse a field selection

blocks.text: The fragment supplies title and pages selections for Book. Both fields appear in the result.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A fragment has to apply to the type at that position.
